title: BECE Business Studies: Office Practice - Business Studies - Office Equipment
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The machines, tools, and furniture used in an organization to facilitate smooth and efficient administrative and clerical work are generally called
questions.explain: **Office equipment** refers to the durable machines and furniture used in the office to speed up work and increase efficiency.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following machines is primarily used by a clerical staff to make exact multiple copies of a single physical document?
questions.explain: A **photocopier** (or copying machine) is specifically used to produce rapid and exact duplicate copies of physical documents.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: To strictly enforce the confidentiality of office information and prevent sensitive physical documents from falling into unauthorized hands, an office should use a
questions.explain: A **shredder** is a mechanical device used to cut paper into tiny strips or fine particles, permanently destroying sensitive or confidential documents.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following items is correctly classified as durable office equipment rather than consumable office stationery?
questions.explain: A **filing cabinet** is a long-lasting, durable piece of furniture used to store files (equipment). Paper, pens, and ink are used up over time (stationery).
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The major importance of introducing modern electronic equipment into a traditional office is to
options: increase the cost of running the business daily
increase speed, accuracy, and overall clerical efficiency
make the office look beautiful but function slowly
encourage workers to sleep during official hours
questions.explain: Modern office equipment handles repetitive and complex tasks automatically, heavily **increasing speed, accuracy, and overall clerical efficiency**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A small hand-operated piece of office equipment used to make uniform holes in paper so they can be neatly bound into a file folder is a
questions.explain: A **perforator** (also known as a hole punch) is used to create holes in sheets of paper to allow them to be secured within a ring binder or folder.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which piece of office equipment is primarily used to securely bind several sheets of paper together permanently using small wire clips?
questions.explain: A **stapler** is used to bind sheets of paper together by driving a thin metal wire (staple) through them and folding the ends.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A large, heavy metallic or wooden furniture consisting of multiple deep drawers, designed specifically for organizing and safely storing office records, is the
questions.explain: A **filing cabinet** is standard office furniture used specifically for keeping files and correspondence properly arranged and secure.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is a highly versatile modern office machine that combines the functions of typing, calculating, data storage, and internet communication?
questions.explain: The **computer** has largely replaced typewriters and simple calculators because it is a multi-functional device capable of word processing, data storage, computation, and communication.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An electronic office machine used to convert printed text and images from a physical piece of paper into a digital file format on a computer is called a
questions.explain: A **scanner** digitizes physical documents by capturing an image of the text/graphics and transferring it to a computer. (A printer does the exact opposite).
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Despite the high importance of modern electronic office equipment, a major challenge or limitation associated with their usage is that they
options: decrease the overall speed of the workers
always print documents in black and white
require steady power supply and regular maintenance
cause documents to be lost constantly
questions.explain: Electronic equipment heavily depends on electricity. Their major drawback is the **requirement for steady power supply and the cost of regular maintenance/repairs**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A machine primarily utilized in the Accounting department to quickly and accurately process large arithmetic figures (additions, subtractions, and multiplications) is the
questions.explain: A **calculator or adding machine** is designed specifically to handle arithmetic operations efficiently and accurately, which is crucial for accounting work.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When an organization heavily equips its office with automated machines to handle highly repetitive manual tasks, it most directly results in
options: a reduction in worker fatigue and human errors
the promotion of all junior workers to managers
the inability to read the visitor's book
a drastic drop in business revenue
questions.explain: Office machines take over the physically and mentally straining repetitive work (like copying or calculating), directly leading to **a reduction in worker fatigue and human errors**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following machines can be found in a standard modern administrative office EXCEPT a
questions.explain: Printers, franking machines (for postage), and scanners are all standard office equipment. A **bulldozer** is heavy construction equipment used in the civil engineering industry, not in an office.
questions.subject: Business Studies
